stories.title: Road expected to reopen overnight after water main break
stories.summary: South Holly Street between East Evans and East Iliff avenues is expected to be closed until Sunday night as Denver Water fixes a broken water main.

stories.title: Broncos' icon Tom Jackson dies at 75
stories.summary: One of the best and most popular players in team history, Jackson later became a Hall of Fame broadcasting analyst with ESPN.

stories.title: Cold and dry for Broncos Sunday with gradual warmup ahead this week
stories.summary: Sunday morning could bring fog, a few flurries and some of the coldest temperatures of the season so far. The afternoon will stay chilly but dry before temperatures.

stories.title: Videos capture intense conditions during Friday I-70 pileup, prompt renewed safety warnings
stories.summary: The messages come after a series of multi-car pileups along I-70 over the course of Friday and Saturday.

stories.title: Family of Commerce City crash victim hopes new street sign will urge drivers to slow down
stories.summary: Family says a permanent sign for Monica Rios goes up next week after her family's cross was repeatedly knocked down.

stories.title: I-70 reopens after 12-car pileup amid snowy conditions
stories.summary: CSP said there was a 12-car pile-up and that there have been multiple spin-offs and slide-outs.

stories.title: Denver Christkindlmarket officially opens for season
stories.summary: The market features dozens of vendors, weekly events and themed nights, and a 110-foot-tall LED holiday tree.

stories.title: Fort Collins women warn others about cyclist who slapped, grabbed them
stories.summary: Fort Collins Police are asking for the public’s help identifying a bicyclist accused of groping multiple women in a residential neighborhood.

stories.title: Preschool teacher honors late partner on first Transgender Day of Remembrance without him
stories.summary: Kirsten DeVon Herman used to observe the day of remembrance alongside her partner, Voss Barclay. She never imagined someday she'd be remembering and honoring him.

stories.title: Flight students scrambled to Limon, Boulder and Broomfield while FAA paused Centennial's simultaneous takeoffs
stories.summary: The FAA lifted a pause on simultaneous takeoffs at Centennial Airport, introducing a new procedure to enhance safety.

stories.title: Parking garage under Denver Pavilions could help pay to tear down the mall
stories.summary: The Pavilions’ 800-space garage brings in about $2.8M a year. A report commissioned by the DDA says it could borrow against it to pay to tear down most of the mall.

stories.title: Lafayette elementary school turns former classroom into free ‘family hub’ for families in need
stories.summary: A former classroom at Alicia Sanchez Elementary in Lafayette has transformed into a vital “family hub,” providing free essentials like food and clothing.
